|game_text=Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May deploy Bog Clearing from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, if [Dagobah] Luke in battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move for free using landspeed. While alone, Jedi Ahsoka's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history={{Card errata/Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V)}}
This is version PC-E1 (2 of 2), 11 October 2026. It is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (V)]]): PC card image of 9 October 2026<ref name="ht-dd-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/1f401ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/doordonotwiseadvice.gif doordonotwiseadvice.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/1f401ba5a2c0ecb415b43001cefdb9a2f226553b 1f401ba] (9 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May deploy Bog Clearing from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, if [Dagobah] Luke in battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move free using landspeed. While alone, Jedi Ahsoka's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image of 11 October 2026<ref name="ht-dd-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/doordonotwiseadvice.gif doordonotwiseadvice.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/5aa6ad84446965cd2c9e9567016b93a7bba5876c 5aa6ad8] (11 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: “may move free using landspeed” becomes “may move for free using landspeed”. Text: “Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May deploy Bog Clearing from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, if [Dagobah] Luke in battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move for free using landspeed. While alone, Jedi Ahsoka's game text is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]”
What changed on the card image (crops of the two published images, unchanged pixels):

Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 13 October 2026, under the label “•Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice (V)”. Same words ([[:File:V27-L-doordonotwiseadvice-2026-10-13-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip is part of this version, not a version of its own.
